data.name: Pukhraj
data.gender_notes: Pukhraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pukharaj', which means 'golden flower'. This name signifies beauty, wealth, and prosperity. The name Pukhraj carries the meaning “Golden flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pukhraj usually hope their child will grow to embody golden flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner radiance and beauty of the soul, and the blossoming of spiritual wisdom and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Pukhraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pukhraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
